The '''Kira sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the sector included [[Kira IV]], [[Nigel III]], and [[Nigel VI]].

==History==
Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Kira sector was among the first sectors to throw off the Empire.<ref name="RECG" />
